notes.title: Small Update 1.6
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Updated the in-game fishing rod icons to make them look more professional. 
[*] Updated some English and Japanese text to make the translations smoother (hopefully).
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.5 More fish!
notes.content:
[h3]Add 10 new fish species or aquatic organisms to the game.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crocodile
[*] ​​Guppy
[*] European Bream
[*] Arapaima
[*] Pond Turtle
[*] Red-eared Slider
[*] Softshell Turtle
[*] Stygian Jellyfish
[*] Sea Snail
[*] Giant Clam
[/list]
[h3]Also, some minor bugs have been fixed.[/h3]

notes.title: ​​Minor Update v1.3​
notes.content: Automatically enter fishing mode after encountering the cat—no more manual clicking required.

notes.title: ​​Minor Update v1.2​​
notes.content:
Added fish badges in the fishbucket and fish stall:
Now you can identify which fish your cats prefer and which are suitable as NPC gifts through icon tags.
